name: graph-decode
commands: python3 bench/rexl3/sweep_decode.py --url http://node-2:8000 --model inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --window 262144 --max-total 1048576 --phase both --ctxs 4096 --conc 1,2,4 --modes serial --depth-modes serial --reps 3 --depth-reps 3 --out sweep.json
python3 bench/tools/bench.py --url http://node-2:8000 --model inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --max-model-len 262144 --phases warm,decode,conc,prefill-32k --ref pinned.json

NODE=node-2 LAB_SRC=<engine worktree> PKG=gb-model TEST_ENV='LOOP_PROFILE_STEPS=100 LOOP_LONG_IDS_FILE=<lab>/ids_long.json [REXL3_INKLING2_LOOP_OVERLAP=0]' scripts/ops_dev.sh test inkling2_loop_graphs decode_step_timing
tools/nsys_run.sh NAME   (nsys profile -t cuda --cuda-graph-trace=node on the lab test binary under /tmp/rexl3-gpu.lock)
notes: GPU clock locked at 2200 MHz (sampled 2190 MHz idle after the runs). Medians of 3 after a discarded warm-up. The step times are the in-process decode_step_timing test (one row, 3,800 positions, median of 100); server tok/s only where a server ran. The per-visit gap breakdown is extrapolated from one visit timeline and is an inference. Not measured: c=2/c=4 at 4K prompts (tool limitation), 1M, drafted windows, memory at ready, device memory of the graphs.
